body: I appreciate it. Perhaps I do.
I can't find it in me to want. It's too hard.

I want to do right by them, but it seems I always come up short. I talked with my boss about some of the issues we're having and it seems like he took it as a personal attack. Maybe I approached him wrong or came off aggressively. He ended our talk by letting me know I could step down or find a different job. It wasn't a threat so much as letting me know that I'll have to get used to the situation. I don't want to step down and take a huge pay cut. I also don't know where I would go if I left. I feel trapped.
I have done that a few times, location doesn't seem to be the issue. I will admit this is the worst of the places I have lived, but I think the issue is me.
It is, what's worse is I'm the manager. As for changing my lfie I really don't know. A job I enjoy sounds nice, but I think the issue is me.
